name: io.github.dapr/dapr-mcp-server
title: Dapr MCP Server
description: Dapr state, pub/sub, bindings, secrets, locks, crypto, conversation, actors, invocation as MCP tools

runtimeArguments.description: Skip the image's HTTP health check, which does not apply to stdio

runtimeArguments.name: --network
runtimeArguments.description: Reach the Dapr sidecar on the host. Docker Desktop needs host networking turned on in its settings

packageArguments.description: Serve MCP over stdio instead of the image's default HTTP listener

environmentVariables.name: DAPR_GRPC_PORT
environmentVariables.description: gRPC port of the Dapr sidecar

environmentVariables.name: DAPR_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Dapr API token, if the sidecar requires one

environmentVariables.name: DAPR_MCP_SERVER_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log level, written as JSON to stderr
